name: jeson mor
description: Jeson Mor, the Mongolian knights game, on a nine-by-nine board: nine knights a side on the first and last ranks. A knight that moves off the centre square e5 wins, so a knight has to get to e5 and survive there a move before it can win by stepping away; standing on e5 decides nothing. Taking every enemy knight also wins, and a player with no legal move loses.

provenance.source: Jeson Mor (Fairy-Stockfish's `jesonmor` is another reading: its flagMove gives the other side one more move after a knight reaches e5)
